scope: Real engine plus controlled DOM. Quota, denial, stale read and lower limit fixtures are explicit; no art or canon claim.

checks.name: RLE recorder preserves every command, including facing-independent packed edges
216000 actual captured ticks use one run when idle and never grow beyond the frame cap
Worst-case alternating input is bounded independently of elapsed play duration
Invalid packed commands are rejected without consuming frames; exported runs are detached
A successful archive save is read back, de-duplicated and independent of caller mutations
Quota denial leaves original bytes untouched and exposes an unsaved exportable record
Recovery retry persists the same pending record once after storage becomes writable
Unreadable legacy archive is not replaced; raw backup reproduces every original byte
30 existing records are never silently trimmed to make room for the next match
A changed storage snapshot blocks a stale write instead of replacing another tab
A silently refused write is not advertised as durable persistence
An identical ID with different contents never overwrites the existing entry
Pending storage stays bounded and capture can be suspended rather than dropping archives
Single removal and explicit clear preserve unrelated campaign and experiment keys
Denied deletion never advertises success or discards the only pending copy
Corrupt and oversized import envelopes are rejected before a match is started
Actual main match records compact commands and replays its result and actor state
A real result survives storage quota and remains exportable across a new match
Training consumes no replay memory and does not erase earlier match archives
Recording limit fixture keeps the real victory but saves only a marked excerpt
Manual excerpt is detached and cannot alter ongoing simulation or award a victory
Archive opening pauses current combat and closing restores only its previous state
Two-click deletion and same-version playback are linked to the actual stored selection
Invalid or stale asynchronous file reads do not replace a changed match
Legacy incompatible records stay listed and exportable but cannot start playback
Code and art preservation excludes only the reviewed controller change
